title: the Ninefold Court Rising Anew
author: Ansel Hartwell
blurb: Vesper Winterbourne, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
